stories.title: Russian missiles and drones hit Kyiv overnight, killing one and injuring eight
stories.summary: Russia attacked Kyiv with ballistic missiles and drones overnight, killing one person and wounding eight, according to Ukrainian officials. The strike came as Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Kyiv received no early warning from partners, deepening a dispute with Washington over intelligence and satellite support.

stories.title: Analysis: France reels from its most violent weekend in years as unrest spreads
stories.summary: CNN reported that protests over education and living costs spiralled into deadly, country-wide violence, prompting blame-trading between the French government and police over the response. Similar cost-of-living demonstrations have been reported in Italy and elsewhere in Europe, raising questions about how far the unrest could spread.

stories.title: France hit by worst unrest in years as Macron condemns violence
stories.summary: Cost-of-living and school protests across France turned into riots and looting, with authorities reporting at least 1,800 arrests over the weekend, including roughly 550,000 marchers nationwide on Saturday. Macron vowed an “uncompromising” response ahead of a critical budget vote as his government faced questions over policing failures.

stories.title: Amazon Luna cloud gaming expands inside Prime Video to 12 more countries
stories.summary: Amazon began letting Prime subscribers in Canada, France, Italy and Spain stream Luna games directly inside the Prime Video app on Fire TV at no extra cost, with eight more European countries following in November. The move weaves gaming into the same app Prime members already use for video, part of Amazon’s push at casual players rather than core gamers.

stories.title: OpenAI restores OpenCode access and refunds credits after model-distillation attack
stories.summary: OpenAI restored API access and refunded credits for OpenCode users who were also OpenAI API customers following an attack tied to model distillation. The company also promoted Daybreak Blue, an identity-verified, advanced-security tier for authorized cybersecurity work, and said those conversations are not used for model training.

stories.title: OpenCode says AI distillation attack reached 1.4% of its Console users
stories.summary: OpenCode disclosed on X that a large-scale distillation attack — which harvests a model’s outputs to reproduce its capabilities — affected users who had connected external AI providers, about 1.4% of its Console base. The company said it notified those users and is working with Anthropic, OpenAI and Google as its investigation continues.

stories.title: Vercel Labs adds delta snapshots to its agent-browser CLI
stories.summary: Vercel Labs shipped a snapshot --delta flag for the agent-browser CLI that returns only what changed since the previous snapshot instead of the whole page, cutting token use by up to 73x on form-filling tasks. Snapshots can be saved to a baseline file so diffs survive across sessions.

stories.title: Browns takeaways: defense stuffs Ravens for first place in AFC North
stories.summary: Post-game takeaways credited another dominant Cleveland defensive performance for the 13-10 comeback win that pushed the Browns back atop the AFC North at 4-2. Cleveland leaned on its defense for long stretches while the offense sputtered until the final drive.

stories.title: Browns beat Ravens 13-10 on Andre Szmyt’s walk-off field goal, take first in AFC North
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson connected with Jerry Jeudy for 33 yards to set up Andre Szmyt’s 37-yard field goal on an untimed final snap, giving Cleveland a 13-10 win over Baltimore. The Browns improved to 4-2 and moved into first place in the AFC North; Derrick Henry’s late fumble cost the Ravens, who are also 4-2, and rookie head coach Todd Monken beat the team he coordinated for three seasons.

stories.title: Verstappen hits back at ex-F1 drivers over criticism of 2026 regulations
stories.summary: Max Verstappen responded to former drivers’ criticism of Formula 1’s 2026 rules package, defending the current regulations. The exchange keeps alive a paddock debate over car characteristics and racing quality heading into the United States Grand Prix weekend in Austin.

stories.title: BBC could lose F1 radio rights after 32 years as rival broadcaster weighs a bid
stories.summary: Motorsport.com reported the BBC may lose its long-running Formula 1 radio commentary rights, with a rival broadcaster considering a bid. The BBC has carried F1 radio coverage for 32 years, so a change would alter how UK fans follow races.

stories.title: F1 heads to Austin with Antonelli able to clinch the title at COTA
stories.summary: RacingNews365 published the full United States Grand Prix schedule with Kimi Antonelli 102 points clear of George Russell and in position to become the youngest world champion. Antonelli clinches in Austin only if he wins and Russell finishes ninth or lower and Lewis Hamilton fifth or lower; the weekend uses three practice sessions, qualifying Saturday and the race Sunday, October 25.

stories.title: Mercedes backs a Malaysian F1 return as Sepang night-race idea gathers pace
stories.summary: Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord said Malaysia feels “like a home race” and the team would love to return to Sepang, while lighting supplier Signify said technology would not block a night race. Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam and South Korea are all in the mix as F1 weighs Asian expansion, with Asia set to host nine races in 2027.

stories.title: Columbus airport lets non-ticketed visitors through security with new GateSide program
stories.summary: John Glenn Columbus International Airport rolled out GateSide clearance, giving people without a ticket permission to pass through security and meet travelers at the gate. The program is aimed at people seeing off or greeting passengers, and requires an application in advance.

stories.title: More than $10 million bet on Ohio governor and U.S. Senate races
stories.summary: The Columbus Dispatch reported that betting markets have taken in more than $10 million on Ohio’s governor and U.S. Senate races, on top of record campaign spending. The story examines whether those odds carry any predictive signal as Election Day approaches.

stories.title: Juvenile seriously injured after falling from the roof of a moving car in Columbus
stories.summary: Columbus police reported a juvenile was seriously injured after falling from the roof of a moving vehicle. The incident is under investigation; authorities have not released further details on the circumstances or the driver.

stories.title: Madison Township asks voters for police and fire levies as call volume climbs
stories.summary: Madison Township’s police and fire chiefs pointed to rising costs as they seek additional levies, with the fire department citing 4-5% annual growth in call volume and more than 11,300 calls for service in 2025 across three stations. The levies go before township voters in the November election.
